reviews.text: Do NOT!!! Use this service.  They don’t completely take care of your pool and will leave it looking horrible then blame it on the customer for the reason it looks the way it does.  You will regret every minute they have been servicing your pool.  I’ve included a picture of what they consider acceptable.  Something as simple as them telling you they turned your pump off and why is apparently more than they can handle.  When they came out to look at it and I questioned the service I was receiving

Russell at Pinch A Penny, has definitely gained customers with us.  We had been using anither local pool company for weekly cleankng etc., but were not very happy with their service for the amount we were being charged.  We wanted to begin taking care of our pool ourselves.  Having no clue what we needed, we walked in and had a conversation with Russell.  He was extremely helpful and took the time to really educate us without trying to sell a product.  If you're looking for equipment, chemicals,

We needed some tile and coping repaired and all the mastic replaced. The crew did a great job. They were very nice, did the job quickly and left no mess at all. I’ll definitely use them again if I need any pool repairs.

I just bought a home a few months ago, (first time owning with a pool). After trying to figure out on my own what to do to keep up with my pool I came across a few stores. Leslie’s of course and pinch a penny. When I went to Leslie’s they tried selling me on a bunch of products and also when reading my water levels they said I would have to drain my pool for calcium levels being high at 400-450, I took in my water samples again and another guy said those levels are not bad so I quickly lost cred

First of all, I do not waste time with reviews...BUT I had to BUYER BEWARE!! Recently, Aug 24, 2023, I went into the store while my daughter took her dog to the vet. I asked if they could do a pool drain. The owner explain they could do the service; I was asked to leave a card on file for the technician to come out. I thought no worries, this is a store front, I have better chances here than with some random contractor. I WAS WRONG! Yes, there were stains in the pool which is why I asked for the
This place is incredible.  They helped me with the algae in my pool.  It is almost clear with little work.  They had all the supplies and the owner was great!june1 then 2 and third!!!!

Ok, I've been a lemming. I've been looking to another place (Leslie's) to help and guide me with my pool maintenance. I came into Pinch A Penny when I had gone to several other places trying to get my pool back blue and clear. Russell took my water sample and shared what has been going wrong and guided me through the process of getting it right again. I obviously have been getting VERY bad advice!!!  He even offered to come by the house and assist me!!!  I asked him to please add a service call

I walked into this location hoping to find a good floatie for the weekend. Everywhere around me was sold out! They had so many options for toys/floats. My kids enjoyed how enthusiastic the owner was! He helped us all pick something out! Thanks to him this was my view this last weekend.
I truly appreciate Russ and his staff for being knowledgable, professional, attentive and helping me get my pool ready for the summer! I truly appreciate it!  😇😇😇 …

Russel was a wealth of knowledge.  He really knows his pools.  I ended up trying the liquid chlorine they sell and it has done wonders for me.  This liquid chlorine he sells doesnt have stabilizer in it, so I’ve learned to add one or two chlorine tablets per week.  Between the liquid chlorine and the tablets I put in the pool each week, it’s been life changing!  As long as you check your chemicals and stay on top of your pool each week, Russell will keep you looking good!  And the liquid chlorin
Fantastic experience with them so far. Very friendly, knowledgeable and fair with pricing. Communication has also been great. Highly recommend them for your pool needs
Wow! Great service and so much information about how to care for our pool equipment. I definitely recommend them to anyone with a pool

I am a first time pool owner, the place I bought my pool from said they had classes but they didn't. The pool was installed and I had no idea what to do. I looked for a pool maintenance company but couldn't find any of the list that came up that would help with my above ground pool. My pool filled with algae and nothing  I did helped. I found an add for Pinch a Penny and let me just say Russell is a life saver. My pool is still in ICU but I know it is great hands!

Great customer service very knowledgeable staff and tended to my pools needs without adding extra charges. One particular young man named Brennen at the store was very kind and patient to my new pool owner questions needs. Highly recommend this store.
We came home from vacation to a green pool. Within a few days pinch a penny helped us get it blue and clear again. 100% recommend
Very clean and we’ll kept store. Staff was also extremely knowledgeable and friendly. Highly recommend for all your pool maintenance needs!

Pinch a Penny has gone above and beyond this week to help us get our pump leak repaired.  I highly recommend for all my pool services.  We feel valued as a customer.  Thank you!  I posted this review on June 10, 2024 at 10:46 am on a Monday, I cannot find the  post, so I am reposting!!  I have reported it to google too.

Really good pool store.  The best liquid chlorine.  Also I did not know he did repairs until recently.  He was out to my home very quicky to replace a multiport valve.  Work looks great and he found some glass that blew into my pool and called to let me know so we would not get hurt.  He cares about his customers.
I love coming here for any of my pools needs and the staff is educated on the prime subjects of pool cleaning and services. I also get all my chemicals and weekly cleaning from This company.
Great service! They helped me out a lot and explained everything perfectly. Thanks to Russell our pool was crystal clear for the 4th of July!

data.name: Pinch A Penny Pool Patio Spa

reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this Pinch A   Penny location.  After our pool renovation, we took a break from Pinch a Penny to have a friend clean our pool for a while, against our better judgment. Pinch a Penny has been back for 2 weeks now, and our pool has not looked this good since the renovation was complete.  Their prices are fair, they do excellent work, and they send us a detailed list of what they did with  a picture of the pool each time they clean.  Highly recommend if you’re looking for excellent pool service.
reviews.author: Kay Alton Farr

reviews.text:
We had Pinch-A-Penny come out to renovate our pool and they did an absolutely AMAZING job. They worked incredibly quickly with very keen attention to every detail I had brought to the attention of the young lady Jadyn who was helping get this project done.

Our pool was finished on-time and absolutely hassle free which is a blessing for us seeing as this is our first big home renovation. I'll forever brag on this store. Its great customer service and just sheer willingness and determination to make everything my wife and I wanted come to be is unmatched anywhere else we looked at.

All questions were answered very promptly and anything that we needed and maybe couldn't afford they worked with us on and offered discounts so that our dream could come true. There are not many good places and people like this ourt there so God bless this family owned store and the care they put into their work. It's greatly appreciated!!!
reviews.author: Maconnell

reviews.text: So we have been battling our pool for years and had lost hope that we would ever be able to get it fixed, and then we found Pinch-A-Penny North Dallas. Within minutes, we were able to get a water test and figure out exactly what was wrong with our pool, get the right chemicals, get a new filter and have someone come out to our home to get it to us and it's all thanks to Kristy and her incredible team who worked so hard and didn't stop working hard until everything was perfect! Talk about customer service, the owner and employees at this store are so incredibly knowledgeable about ANYTHING and EVERYTHING!!! Which is amazing because who the heck knows all this pool stuff. There's too much to know and understand, but the people at this store make you feel like family and most importantly they get the problem fixed the RIGHT way! I had so many people tell me so many wrong things, I'm beyond grateful to this store and the owner for helping us so much. I will absolutely be coming here for any and all my pool needs. This experience, professionalism and help was worth every penny at the north dallas Pinch-A-Penny :)
reviews.author: J B

reviews.text:
Awesome experience, this is a family run store at Frankford and North Dallas tollway and they stand behind their word. Owner Kristie made several visits to ensure that we were happy with the progress while Jayden seamlessly coordinated the different teams since we did new raised stone flower beds, replaced covered patio floor tiles, resurfaced pool deck, resurfaced the pool with some altering of the steps with adding safety rails. Between Jayden’s knowledge and experience along with the crew’s suggestions beautifully transformed our backyard. 100% recommend Pinch a Penny.
The Garcia’s
reviews.author: Junior

reviews.text: We got exactly what we paid for and we appreciated the professional service and follow through
reviews.author: Brent Smith

reviews.text: Our pool guy, Brandon does an amazing job keeping our pool looking terrific. Polite, focused and very reliable. So glad he maintains our pool!
reviews.author: Ty Gaston

reviews.text: My pool always looks great. I recommend this service and company. It’s a huge relief that I can depend on them to always be consistent and take great care of my pool.
reviews.author: Laura Larry

reviews.text:
I was a customer of Leslies for a while, as I took over my own pool care in July 2022, when my pool tech thought 320ppm CYA and 15ppm chlorine was just fine.

Leslies kept trying to sell me junk bottled chlorine and I finally gave up after spending $160 of liquid chlorine to SLAM one weekend (that wouldn't raise my tiny 10K pool to more than 12ppm Chlorine). I went to PAP and they were too nice, offering me a FREE 2.5 gallon jug to start and I paid for the other. SLAM was easy with fresh chlorine. Returned many times before I converted to Salt water.  The chlorine was super fresh every visit!

Anyway, I did have a vacuum hose I purchased at PAP that sprang a leak and they gladly accepted the return and got me a new one that hasn't had any leaks!

I bought all my Salt Water supplies here too, cause they were cheaper than Amazon.

The staff is super nice and very open to hearing about any issues you might have.

I would recommend these folks over any Leslies pool supply, give them a look!
reviews.author: Mark Armstrong
